found.desc: Cyfartha Castle, Merthyr Tydfil. This is actually a mansion with castellation and turrets to partially mimic a defensive structure, and was designed in 1824 for the Crawshay family. It came into the hands of the Town Council in 1908, with the ground floor converted to a museum and the upper parts to a school. The locomotive is a replica of the Penydarren locomotive, which on 14 February 1804 took a train from Merthyr Tydfil to Navigation House (now Abercynon) and thus proved the viability of the steam powered railway.
